annotation.title_clean: Правовые аспекты гражданско-правовой ответственности за причинение вреда действиями робота как квазисубъекта гражданско-правовых отношений
annotation.title_en: Legal Aspects of Civil Liability for Damages in Tort as a Result of Actions of a Robot as a Quasi-Subject of Civil Legal Relations
annotation.venue: Гуманитарная информатика (Humanitarian Informatics), Tomsk State University
annotation.summary_en: Russian journal article on civil tort liability for harm caused by autonomous AI robots. It proposes distinguishing AI robots from mechanisms, introducing the robot as a quasi-subject of civil law, and a classifier of tort categories, damage levels and responsible persons (inventor, programmer, manufacturer, owner/user, third party).
key_provisions_or_claims: Divide robots into AI-equipped autonomous 'Robots' and non-AI machine-mechanisms.
Introduce the Robot as a quasi-subject of civil legal relations in the Civil Code.
Autonomous robot is neither a source of increased danger nor a defective product under current Russian law.
Candidate liable persons: inventor, programmer, manufacturer, owner/user, third party.
Propose a classifier of tort categories (A-C), damage levels and responsible persons (I-IV) tied to economic activity codes.
